title: A rerun with unchanged choices changes no bytes
statement: Running setup twice with the same inputs against the same project leaves every file it owns byte-identical, including the settings file, the ignore block, the project identity file and the generated skills. The comparison is over file bytes, not over a reported status.
notes: PASS 2026-09-23 on EVD-0138. A second run naming nothing reads back the committed selection and this host's approval of it, asks no question, and leaves every file byte-identical — the whole tree by digest rather than a reported status — including the settings file, the ignore block, the identity file and the generated content; the compatibility record too, and the live check is not run again. A third run leaves the identity file's mtime untouched, so nothing is rewritten with identical bytes.
